source: Google Search Console performance, page indexing and sitemap reports

queries.query: professional video drm service in varanasi

page_indexing_report.status: stale relative to the performance and sitemap reports
page_indexing_report.note: The report displayed zero indexed pages, but later Search performance impressions show that Google served multiple SiteSutra URLs. It is not used as the current index count.

comparison.interpretation: The windows overlap and the current report ends on the experiment release date, so the difference is directional context rather than a before-and-after result.

decisions: Keep the existing technical SEO, local marketing and website-development canonical pages, titles and H1s stable until the report contains several completed post-release days.
Do not create separate pages for consultant, consultancy, company or agency variants; the existing technical SEO page already answers the shared audit intent.
Do not rewrite snippets to chase CTR while the main query group is appearing around positions 84 to 97; there is no meaningful click opportunity sample yet.
Treat the Form / Space queries as concept-name ambiguity and the video DRM query as irrelevant noise rather than expanding the service offer.
Leave the successful submitted sitemap in place; Google read it on 27 October and no resubmission is required for the same sitemap URL.
limitations: Search Console reports were delayed by 72 hours and the performance window ended on 25 October.
The three-day experiment was merged to production on 25 October at 09:40 Asia/Kolkata, leaving no complete post-change period in this report.
The windows used for comparison overlap, so changes in impressions or position cannot be attributed to the experiment.
Search Console can omit low-volume query rows, so visible query impressions do not sum to the property total.
The sample is too small to infer keyword demand, CTR performance or a durable ranking trend.
